state_limits: Child HEAD equals parent pin; git status --short --untracked-files=all was empty. Benchmark record files were not opened or rerun.
description: A deterministic software-engineering research harness that uses a small local model in bounded plan/implement/verify/claim steps and a blind external grader.
scope_audience: Completed research campaign for people evaluating verification workflows with a fixed 4B model and 40-task corpus; the hoped-for repository-fixing CLI is not implemented.

creativity.reason: The blind grader, machine-readable evidence gate and measured workflow ablations form an interesting integration; global originality is not established.

current_usefulness.reason: The harness and negative findings can inform research, but the consumer-facing helpagent command is absent and findings are tied to one setup.

expected_usefulness.reason: If the scoped engineering workflow achieved its stated goals, evidence-backed repository repair would be important; this rating is conditional, not a success forecast.

impl_progress.reason: The campaign harness, structural gate and recorded head-to-head/ablation results are integrated; goals remain unresolved and product CLI is absent.

presentability.reason: README and STATUS explain protocol, conditions, estimates, negative results and limits clearly, though no product command is available to a fresh user.

verification: README, STATUS and representative leaf-loop source inspected; measured numbers are project-reported at the stated revision, not independently recomputed or executed here.

evidence.locator: What it does; Final measured results; Conclusion
Fair comparison precondition; The three requirements
Leaf loop contract; claim gate and test-report checks

contribution: A research campaign that documents inconclusive parity, mixed verification effects and a negative result for its current decomposition bundle, with explicit limits against overgeneralization.
alternatives_question: Which current coding-agent evaluation harnesses use the same blind task-level grader and delivery-revision audit, and what evidence would show this protocol adds a distinct capability?

delivery_likelihood.reason: The campaign is closed and the proposed user-facing repository-fixing CLI does not exist; no continuation is planned.

reason: Substantial, candid experimental work supports keeping the research record; unresolved product goals and narrow evaluation scope do not support a product showcase claim.
next_step: Preserve the scoped negative findings; any revived product claim needs a separate unseen-repository end-to-end evaluation.
inspection_limits: No source projects were changed, installed, built, executed, tested, or accessed over a network; no child commits or pushes were made.

All initialized child repositories matched their parent gitlink and had empty `git status --short --untracked-files=all`; this does not inspect ignored/generated data. The local_lm_research submodule was reported uninitialized and left unknown.
The parent repository revision advanced during this investigation; `parent_revision` records the observed revision at report completion. Assigned child gitlink pins remained unchanged.

No public alternatives research or global novelty claim is included. All implementation/runtime, visual, security and performance claims are limited to inspected source or explicitly attributed project documentation; the parent owns external comparisons and synthesis.
For learn_draw, only structural product intent and source were inspected; private/personal payloads, target imagery, artwork and live work records were excluded.
